findings.finding: The saved B.Cu GND zone fill is stale: it clears J1 pad 1 (+5V, THT, solder side) by only 0.1275 mm, while the zone's own clearance is 0.5 mm. A refill gives 0.5005 mm. The fab Gerbers carry the stale fill (fresh export from the saved board diffs 0 lines against fab/gerbers). DRC and dfm_check pass it because 0.1275 >= the 0.127 floor.
findings.evidence: kicad_pcb filled_polygon cutout x 9.7725-12.0275, y 17.8025-20.0575 around pad (10.9,18.93) 2.0x2.0 -> 0.1275 mm; zone connect_pads clearance 0.5; kicad-cli pcb drc --refill-zones on a copy: cutout edge x 9.3995 (0.5005 mm). B_Cu.gbl contains X9772500Y-17917441. jlc_capabilities.yaml 2layer_1oz min_clearance_mm 0.127.
findings.fix: Refill zones (kicad-cli pcb drc --refill-zones --save-board, or pcbnew B) and re-export fab/gerbers; re-run dfm_check.
findings.margin: 0.1275 mm vs 0.127 JLC floor: +0.4%; vs the zone's 0.5 mm: -75%
findings.class_mode: Zone fill saved stale (not refilled after an edit), so the copper and Gerbers carry clearances the zone's own rule forbids while DRC and DFM pass at the fab floor

findings.finding: Board is 13.40 x 10.50 mm with no fiducials; the short side is 0.5 mm over the commonly quoted JLC PCBA 10 mm minimum. JLC may add edge rails/panelize for assembly (cost, not function).
findings.evidence: Edge.Cuts x 7.475-20.875, y 14.95-25.45, r1.0 corners; no fiducial footprints. JLC PCBA minimum size not in jlc_capabilities.yaml (unverified).
findings.fix: None; accept JLC's rails if quoted.

findings.finding: Both GND vias are JLC-standard 0.6/0.3 (annulus 0.15 = floor) and sit 0.13-0.14 mm from SMD pad edges (D1 pad 1, C1 pad 2). They are tented (no F/B mask openings), same net, so wicking risk is low.
findings.evidence: Vias (18.8312,20.7525) and (13.2,21.74), 0.6/0.3; D1 pad1 edge x 18.40 vs via edge 18.53; C1 pad2 edge y 21.30 vs via edge 21.44. F_Mask/B_Mask gerbers: no flashes at via coordinates.
findings.margin: annulus 0.15 vs 0.15: 0%; via-to-pad copper 0.13 mm (same net, tented)
